author_bio.name: Kung Fu Panda Quotes
author_bio.description:
Kung Fu Panda Quotes brings the wisdom, humor, and philosophy from all four Kung Fu Panda films directly to your TRMNL device.

Features:
🐼 80+ authentic quotes from all 4 Kung Fu Panda movies
🎭 8 themed collections: Wisdom, Humor, Growth, Combat, Identity, Confidence, Iconic, Villainy
🎨 Beautiful movie poster displays optimized for e-ink
🔄 Daily automatic quote updates with intelligent rotation


Setup:
1. Install or Fork this recipe
2. Choose your preferred quote theme (or "All Themes" for variety)
3. The plugin automatically polls for a new quote every 24 hours
4. Add to your playlist and experience daily wisdom from the Valley of Peace

Experience the timeless wisdom of Master Oogway, the humor of Po, the discipline of Master Shifu, and memorable quotes from all your favorite characters across the entire franchise.

"Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift. That is why it is called the present." - Master Oogway

author_bio.name: About This Plugin
author_bio.description:
TRMNL Google Photos Canvas displays your Google Photos shared album in a clean, immersive, fullscreen layout — no captions, no metadata, just your photos edge to edge.

How It Works:
1. Create a shared album in Google Photos
2. Copy the shared album link
3. Paste it below in the recipe settings
4. Enjoy a new random photo every hour or day (based on your TRMNL refresh settings)

Features:
🖼️ Fullscreen, distraction-free photo display
🌈 Adaptive background color based on image being displayed (optional)
⚡ Fast loading with optional caching
🔒 No sign-in, no tracking, privacy-first

custom_fields.name: Google Photos Shared Album URL
custom_fields.description: Paste your Google Photos shared album link (e.g., https://photos.app.goo.gl/ABC123)
custom_fields.help_text: To create a shared album: Google Photos → Create → Shared Album → Get Link. Make sure link sharing is enabled. Leave blank to see a demo photo.

custom_fields.name: Adaptive Background
custom_fields.description: Match background color to photo edge for seamless display
custom_fields.help_text: When enabled, the background shade adapts to each photo for a more immersive look. Adds ~100-200ms to loading. Disable for pure white background.

custom_fields.name: Enable Performance Caching
custom_fields.description: Cache photo info for faster loading
custom_fields.help_text: When enabled, the plugin remembers your album's photos for 24 hours for instant loading. No actual photos are stored. Disable for always-fresh photos (slower).

author_bio.name: About This Plugin
author_bio.description:
Google Photos Shared Album brings your cherished memories to your TRMNL device by displaying random photos from your Google Photos shared albums — no sign-in needed.

How It Works:
1. Create a shared album in Google Photos
2. Copy the shared album link
3. Paste it into the plugin settings
4. Photos automatically appear on your TRMNL device
5. New random photo displayed every hour or day based on your refresh configuration

Features:
📸 Random photo selection from your shared albums
⏰ Automatic refresh with new random photos
🎨 Four optimized layouts for all TRMNL device sizes
📱 Responsive design across all e-ink displays
🖼️ Display photo metadata

Privacy-First Design: This plugin prioritizes your privacy - no need to sign in with Google. No cookies, no tracking, and we never save your personal information.

custom_fields.name: Google Photos Shared Album URL
custom_fields.description: Paste your Google Photos shared album link (e.g., https://photos.app.goo.gl/ABC123)
custom_fields.help_text: To create a shared album, open Google Photos → Create → Shared Album → Get Link. Ensure link sharing is enabled. Leave blank to see a demo photo.

custom_fields.name: Display Name
custom_fields.description: Custom name to show in the title bar (optional)
custom_fields.help_text: This name appears in the plugin's title bar. Leave blank to use the plugin name (Google Photos Shared Album).

custom_fields.name: Show Photo Year
custom_fields.description: Display the photo year in the bottom right corner
custom_fields.help_text: When enabled, the year from the photo's date appears in the bottom right corner with a white stroke for visibility. Disable if you prefer a cleaner photo display.

custom_fields.name: Show Photo Details
custom_fields.description: Display photo date, size, and count in the title bar
custom_fields.help_text: When enabled, shows photo details like date, size, and total count (e.g., '2 years ago • 12MP • 142 photos'). When disabled, only shows photo count for a cleaner look.

custom_fields.name: Enable Performance Caching
custom_fields.description: Save photo information temporarily for faster loading (recommended)
custom_fields.help_text: When enabled, we temporarily remember which photos are in your album for 24 hours so everything loads instantly. Your actual photos are never saved - we just remember they exist. Disable this to always fetch fresh photos directly from Google (takes a few seconds longer, but nothing is saved).

author_bio.name: About This Plugin
author_bio.description:
Element of the Day brings the wonder of chemistry to your TRMNL device by displaying a different element from the Periodic Table each day (or hour).

Features:
🔬 118 elements with comprehensive scientific data
⏰ Daily rotation or hourly random display modes
📊 Atomic number, mass, electron configuration, and more
🎨 Periodic table-style card design
📱 Four optimized layouts (Full, Half Horizontal, Half Vertical, Quadrant)
⚡ Fast static data delivery via GitHub Pages
🧪 Data sourced from PubChem database

Setup:
1. Install or Fork this recipe
2. Choose your preferred display mode (Daily or Hourly)
3. Select your favorite layout size
4. Add to your playlist and learn chemistry one element at a time

Perfect for students, educators, science enthusiasts, or anyone curious about the building blocks of matter. Each element includes atomic properties, physical characteristics, and historical discovery information.

Data Source: All 118 elements verified from PubChem (National Center for Biotechnology Information)

author_bio.name: About This Plugin
author_bio.description:
Durham Waste Collection displays your next garbage, recycling, green bin, and yard waste pickup dates directly on your TRMNL device.

Features:
🗓️ Real-time updates from Durham Region API
♻️ All collection types (Blue Box, Green Bin, Garbage, Yard Waste)
📱 Optimized layouts for all TRMNL view sizes
🎨 Beautiful icons for each collection type
⏰ Countdown display showing days until next pickup

Setup:
1. Visit our Configuration Helper to find your Place ID:
https://hossain-khan.github.io/trmnl-next-pickup-plugin/
2. Enter your Durham Region address
3. Copy the configuration values
4. Paste them into the plugin form fields below

That's it! Your plugin will automatically refresh with the latest pickup schedule.

Note: This plugin is designed for Durham Region, Ontario residents only.
